title: What If All the Water on Earth Vanished? #shorts
description:
How long do you think you'd last? 👇

What if every drop of water on Earth vanished, except the water inside you? The oceans empty, the rain stops and the plants dry out, and you would have about three days.
The deepest point of the ocean is about 11 km down, so Mount Everest (8.8 km) would fit inside it.
#whatif #water #earth #science #shorts

beats.text: Every drop of water on Earth just vanished.
beats.speaker: sci

beats.text: In one second, the oceans are gone. Every ship drops onto the seafloor.
beats.speaker: narrador

beats.text: The deepest spot is now a hole eleven kilometers deep. Mount Everest would fit inside.
beats.speaker: narrador

beats.text: Fine. I'll just buy a bottle.
beats.speaker: guy

beats.text: Empty. So is every pipe, every lake, every cloud.
beats.speaker: sci

beats.text: No clouds means no rain. Ever again.
beats.speaker: narrador

beats.text: Plants lost their water too. Only yours survived.
beats.speaker: sci

beats.text: And you lose water with every breath. Most people last about three days without a drink.
beats.speaker: narrador

beats.text: So how long do I have?
beats.speaker: guy

idea.premisa: Gancho elegido analizando vídeos parecidos (ver analisis_gancho); imagen ya en pantalla en el segundo 0; diálogo corto.

analisis_gancho.que_gancho_usan: Los que vuelan enseñan en el primer fotograma una imagen imposible y la dicen con una afirmación contraintuitiva sobre algo cotidiano (el agua). Los flojos son premisas abstractas sin imagen clara.
analisis_gancho.funcionaria_aqui: Sí: el agua es cotidiana y la imagen (océano vacío, barco varado) se entiende sin sonido. Pero nuestra retención dice que repetir la premisa justo después ("Every drop?") es la mayor fuga, así que se quita y el giro personal entra en el segundo 2.
analisis_gancho.decision: Afirmación de choque + imagen ya en pantalla: "Every drop of water on Earth just vanished." + "Except the water inside you." (amenaza directa al espectador).
